description: A 14HP expander for the FroeZe sequencer, placed immediately to its left: it gives each of the fifteen instrument tracks its own swing CV input.

inputs.text: Sets the swing for that track alone by voltage, in place of the single swing FroeZe applies to the whole pattern

notes: a track's CV is read only after its box on the expander's screen is switched on with a left click. The boxes are drawn in one widget, so they cannot be reached by clicking for help.
switching on even one track here disables FroeZe's own %SWING input: its LED turns red and the two-digit display below it shows two dashes.
the expander works only when it touches the left edge of a FroeZe module, and it takes that module's panel model and display brightness.
this expander has no menu of its own beyond the licence line; the panel model and the sequencer's settings are on the FroeZe module's menu.
